tickets.title: Prepare Lila's first-year college funding schedule
tickets.text: Map Lila Pebblefizz's $79,400 first-year cost at Buttonwood Balloon University against the $12,000 merit scholarship, the $103,800 Velvet Acorn Custody 529 account, and available Teacup Comet Bank checking cash, showing the order and timing of funding sources for Nadia Pebblefizz and Owen Pebblefizz.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that first-year college funding schedule by 2025-02-21.

tickets.title: Prepare Lila 529 investment positioning review
tickets.text: Review the Lila Pebblefizz Velvet Acorn Custody 529 account's roughly 70% equity-oriented and 30% short-term bond and cash allocation, and prepare risk-reduction options ahead of the next tuition withdrawal decision for Nadia Pebblefizz and Owen Pebblefizz.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the Lila 529 investment positioning review by 2025-02-24.

tickets.title: Collect university aid and billing documents
tickets.text: Obtain the final Buttonwood Balloon University billing statement, itemized fee schedule, and complete financial aid portal export from Nadia Pebblefizz and Owen Pebblefizz so the confirmed net amount owed after Lila Pebblefizz's $12,000 merit scholarship can be determined.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect the university aid and billing documents by 2025-02-18.

tickets.title: Resolve housing deposit credit mismatch
tickets.text: Reconcile the accepted housing deposit that appears in the Buttonwood Balloon University payment portal but is missing from Nadia Pebblefizz's printed student account statement, and confirm the correct remaining balance to fund for Lila Pebblefizz.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the housing deposit credit mismatch by 2025-02-20.

tickets.title: Follow up on account security concern
tickets.text: Contact Nadia Pebblefizz and Owen Pebblefizz to confirm whether access has been secured, recommend password and multifactor authentication review, document any suspicious activity, and escalate to Velvet Acorn Custody if unauthorized access or transactions are suspected. Owen Pebblefizz's Velvet Acorn Custody 529 login was locked after an identity-verification attempt, and both parents need to view the education account before withdrawal planning.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address Owen’s locked 529 account access by 2025-02-17.

tickets.title: Update college cash flow for Owen's reduced schedule
tickets.text: Update the education funding plan for Nadia Pebblefizz and Owen Pebblefizz to reflect Owen Pebblefizz's reduced four-day schedule at Paper Otter Works, which lowered his salary from $142,000 to $112,000, while preserving at least six months of core household expenses in cash.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to reflect the effect of Owen’s reduced work schedule on college cash flow by 2025-03-03.

tickets.title: Prepare payment plan and borrowing comparison
tickets.text: Compare the Buttonwood Balloon University monthly payment plan, a home equity line draw against the $120,000 limit, and a limited taxable brokerage sale for any first-year shortfall remaining after scholarship and 529 funding for Nadia Pebblefizz and Owen Pebblefizz.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the payment plan and short-term borrowing comparison by 2025-03-10.

tickets.title: Review concentrated position risk and planning choices
tickets.text: Assess Nadia Pebblefizz's concentrated Silver Marmot Robotics holding, document the risk profile, identify tax-aware diversification options, and prepare recommendations suitable for client review. Include the position size, cost basis status, account registration, liquidity needs, restrictions, and any employer or insider-trading considerations using placeholders where client-specific facts will be added. The Silver Marmot Robotics position is worth about $286,000 in a Velvet Acorn Custody taxable brokerage account, roughly 22% of Nadia and Owen Pebblefizz's investable assets, with an estimated $171,000 unrealized long-term gain, and scenarios should fund part of Lila Pebblefizz's college shortfall without an unnecessarily large one-time concentrated-position reduction.

subTasks.title: Gather position facts and restrictions
subTasks.text: Collect current holding value, percentage of portfolio, account type, estimated cost basis, holding period, dividend or income profile, trading restrictions, blackout windows, and any pledged or restricted-share status.

subTasks.title: Model diversification and tax scenarios
subTasks.text: Compare potential sale, staged sale, charitable gifting, exchange fund, hedging, or hold strategies as applicable. Estimate tax impact, cash flow effect, and portfolio concentration change for each reasonable option.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor recommendation summary
subTasks.text: Summarize key risks, viable strategies, tradeoffs, implementation requirements, and open questions for advisor review before client presentation.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the Silver Marmot Robotics stock concentration and tuition funding scenarios by 2025-03-05.

tickets.title: Tax Document Collection Starter
tickets.text: Coordinate the needed tax document list with the CPA for Nadia Pebblefizz and Owen Pebblefizz's 2024 tax file, gathering the education-related statements for Lila Pebblefizz's dual-enrollment coursework and the record of Iris Pebblefizz's $8,000 college gift that remains in the household checking account.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to coordinate that needed tax document list with the CPA by 2025-02-19.

tickets.title: Coordinate beneficiary update request
tickets.text: Confirm the requested beneficiary update, obtain the correct custodian or carrier form, prepare instructions for completion, and track the request through confirmation. Use placeholders for account registration, beneficiary names, relationship details, percentage allocations, and required signatures. Coordinate the update process for Nadia Pebblefizz and Owen Pebblefizz's Velvet Acorn Custody 529 accounts, whose successor-owner fields were completed years ago and may no longer align with Sera Bramblequill, the successor fiduciary named in the current estate documents.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address 529 successor-owner alignment by 2025-02-28.
